race.title: Lincolnshire Rural Support Network Handicap Chase
race.verdict: NOBLE RECALL has proved consistent this autumn and can go one place better than he did at this track last month. Miss Denver is also shortlisted swiftly returned to chasing, whilst Crac de Megaudais also merits consideration on the back of his Stratford success. NOBLE RECALL MISS DENVER CRAC DE MEGAUDAIS (FR)
